name: qmd-search
description: Search a QMD knowledge-base index from a polished VS Code sidebar.
author: Thomas Hegghammer

qmdSearch.executablePath.description: QMD executable name or path. The extension also checks common Bun, local-bin, and npm user install locations.

enumDescriptions: Hybrid search with query expansion and reranking.
qmdSearch.defaultMode.description: Search mode selected when the QMD Search view first opens.

enumDescriptions: Run one structured vector query without expansion or reranking. Lower latency.
Run QMD vsearch with query expansion. Higher recall but substantially slower.
qmdSearch.vectorSearchMode.description: Vector search strategy. Use expanded on hardware where QMD's query expansion latency is acceptable.

qmdSearch.maxResults.description: Maximum number of ranked QMD results shown for one search.

qmdSearch.resultFontFamily.description: CSS font family used in result cards. Leave empty to use the editor font family.

qmdSearch.resultFontSize.description: Base font size in pixels for result cards.

qmdSearch.resultTextColor.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty string or a hex colour such as #d4d4d4.
qmdSearch.resultTextColor.description: Optional hex colour for result-card text. Leave empty to use the current VS Code theme colours.

qmdSearch.resultLinkColor.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty string or a hex colour such as #4daafc.
qmdSearch.resultLinkColor.description: Optional hex colour for source links in result cards. Leave empty to use the current VS Code theme colour.

qmdSearch.resultBorderColor.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty string or a hex colour such as #666666.
qmdSearch.resultBorderColor.description: Optional hex colour for the border around each result card. Leave empty to use the current VS Code theme colours.

qmdSearch.snippetLines.description: Maximum number of snippet lines shown for each result.

enumDescriptions: Show result metadata on separate lines.
Show rank, title, and score on one line, with the source path below.

qmdSearch.compactSpacing.description: Reduce vertical padding, gaps, and snippet line spacing to fit more results in the sidebar.

enumDescriptions: Do not distinguish matching keyword terms.
Show matching keyword terms in bold.
Show matching keyword terms in italics.
qmdSearch.keywordHighlight.description: Style used to highlight matching terms in keyword and hybrid result titles and snippets.

qmdSearch.keywordHighlightColor.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty string or a hex colour such as #ffcc00.
qmdSearch.keywordHighlightColor.description: Optional hex text colour for highlighted keyword terms. Leave empty to keep the current text colour.

qmdSearch.collections.description: Up to five QMD collection names to show as search checkboxes. Leave empty to search all collections included by default.

qmdSearch.index.description: Optional named QMD index. Leave empty to use QMD's default or project-local index.
